# ympes

ympes provides a collection of lightweight helper functions (imps) both
for interactive use and for inclusion within other packages. These
include functions for visualising colour palettes, quoting user input,
searching rows of a data frame and a set of minimal assertion functions.

![Illustration of an imp looking at a hand of playing cards. Published
on page 193 of Le grand Etteilla, ou, l'art de tirer les
cartes.](reference/figures/750px-Imp_with_cards_-_illustration_from_Le_grand_Etteilla.jpg)

You can install the released version of ympes from
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/) with:

``` r

install.packages("ympes")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Image from [Le grand Etteilla, ou, l’art de tirer les
cartes](https://archive.org/details/b29321220/page/192/mode/2up). Author
Simon Blocquel (1780–1863, under the pseudonym Julia Orsini). B+W
version (and details) obtained from
[wikipedia](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Imp_with_cards_-_illustration_from_Le_grand_Etteilla.jpg).

# Package index

## Combine

- [`cc()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/cc.md) :
  Quote names

## Finding things

- [`greprows()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/greprows.md)
  [`greplrows()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/greprows.md)
  [`grepvrows()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/greprows.md)
  : Pattern matching on data frame rows
- [`fstrcapture()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/fstrcapture.md)
  [`gstrcapture()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/fstrcapture.md)
  : Capture string tokens into a data frame

## Plotting

- [`plot_palette()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/plot_palette.md)
  : Plot a colour palette

## Miscellaneous

- [`new_name()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/new_name.md)
  : Generate column names for a data frame
- [`as_codepoint()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/as_codepoint.md)
  : Covert non-ASCII values to escaped codepoints
- [`to_string()`](https://timtaylor.github.io/ympes/dev/reference/to_string.md)
  : Collapse object to a single, comma-seperated, string
